title: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 Davao Leg 3 Review: What the 2026 Race Was Like
seo_title: Trilogy Run Davao Leg 3 2026 Review: 32K, Cut-offs, Humidity
meta_description: Trilogy Run Asia Davao Leg 3 2026 review: the 32K from Azuela Cove, 100% humidity at the 3am listed start, six-hour cut-off, full results depth and how it qualifies you for the finals marathon.
dek: What the closing leg of RUNRIO's Davao trilogy was like on 27 September 2026: the 32K and its six-hour limit, the saturated early-morning air, the results from front to back, and what Leg 3 means for the National Finals marathon.
verdict: Enter if you are in Mindanao and building towards a marathon. Leg 3's 32K is a supported long run with a six-hour limit, and finishing it, after the 16K and 21K legs, is what qualifies you for the 42K at the National Finals on 8 November. In 2026, 421 runners finished the 32K; the median time was 4:26:13 and every finisher came in under six hours. The front is quick: the men's race was won in 1:57:16 and the women's in 2:35:26. The catch is the air. At the 3am listed start Davao airport recorded 25°C and 100% humidity, and 29°C by 8am. Start slower than you think and aim to be done before 8am.

sections.heading: The Course: Out and Back from Azuela Cove
paragraphs: SunStar Davao described the 2024 and 2025 Leg 3, the 2025 Leg 2 and the 2026 opening leg all as out-and-back courses from Azuela Cove in Lanang [1][2][3][4]. The 2026 Leg 3 was again based at Azuela Cove [5].

No route map, list of roads or aid-station plan was posted on the race pages [6][7][8]. The rules say only that parts of the route are closed under the city's traffic advisory, and that runners must stay inside the barriers and cones marking the course [7][8]. If you want to know where the turn is and where the water is, ask the organiser or a local club before race day.

sections.heading: The Weather: Saturated Air Before Dawn
paragraphs: The race was listed for 3am on Sunday 27 September [6]. Davao's airport, about 3 km north of Azuela Cove, recorded 25°C at 3am with a dew point of 25°C, 100% humidity and a 2-knot wind. It stayed at 25°C to 26°C and 94% to 100% humidity until 6am, then warmed to 27°C at 7am, 29°C at 8am and 30°C at 9am [9].

A dew point of 25°C means the air is fully saturated: sweat does not evaporate, so the body loses little heat however slowly you run. Taking 3am as the start, the median 32K runner (4:26:13) finished at about 7.30am, and the slowest just before 9am, in 29°C to 30°C air [10][9]. Pace the first half gently.

sections.heading: Cut-offs and Rules
paragraphs: The limits are six hours for the 32K, four for the 21K, two for the 10K and one for the 5K, and only finishers inside them get a medal [7]. The 32K limit is generous: every one of the 421 finishers in the results came in under six hours, the slowest in 5:58:58 [10]. A few runners in the shorter races are listed past their limits, one in the 21K, four in the 10K and six in the 5K [10].

You must start within 15 minutes of your flag-off or be disqualified, unofficial pacers are banned, and top places are decided on gun time [7]. The race village has baggage counters, changing tents and portable toilets [8]. At the 2025 Leg 2 at the same venue, finishers were given taho, ice cream, burgers, bananas and bottled water [4].

sections.heading: Why Leg 3 Matters: The 32K and the Marathon
paragraphs: The Trilogy series runs three legs a year in each host city, with distances rising from leg to leg [6]. In Davao that meant a 16K on 29 March, a 21K on 14 June and the 32K on 27 September [11]. The 42K at the National Finals, on 8 November, is reserved for runners who finish the 16K in Leg 1, the 21K in Leg 2 and the 32K in Leg 3, in any host city [8][11][5].

Davao's was the last Leg 3 of the year, after Iloilo on 23 August, Manila on 6 September, Cebu on 13 September and Cagayan de Oro on 20 September [11], so it was the final chance in 2026 to complete the qualifying set. RUNRIO president Rio de la Cruz told the Daily Tribune the 32K is where runners hit the wall, and that from there they need only 10K more for a full marathon [12].

sections.heading: How Fast the Field Is
paragraphs: Rico Bansilan won the 32K in 1:57:16, ahead of the 2025 winner Rino Satinitigan (2:05:54) and Paul James Zafico (2:15:14) [10][1]. Leedy Erika Villamonte, who also won in 2025, took the women's race in 2:35:26, from Yahchevah Daligdig (2:47:28) and Georgina Espejo (3:16:36) [10][1]. For comparison, the 2025 32K was won in 2:03:07 and 2:39:49 [1], and the 2024 race in 1:53:58 and 2:36:44 [3].

Behind the podium the field opens up. Tenth place was 2:46:13 for men and 3:29:05 for women; only 23 runners broke three hours and 133 broke four [10]. Women made up 117 of the 32K finishers, against 282 men [10], so a woman running under 3:30 finished in the top ten.

In the 21K Mark Luigi Joyce won in 1:12:11 and Yahsharah Daligdig in 1:36:36; tenth place was 1:56:22 and 2:25:51, and the median finish 2:51:22 [10]. The 10K went to Aaron Sabal in 35:18 and Kate Duffy Gel Mcdowell in 42:52. In the 5K the fastest woman, Lliane Pearl Redoblado, ran 19:26, faster than any man [10]. The first three in each race win cash and a trophy, and the top three in each 32K age group get medals if they registered at least a week before [7].

sections.heading: Field Size and Race Weekend Logistics
paragraphs: Leg 3 was smaller than the rest of the Davao series. The results list 1,146 finishers [10], against 1,249 at Leg 2 [13] and 2,279 at Leg 1, which KinetixSports put at about 2,700 runners [14][2]. The 2024 Leg 3 had drawn at least 2,700 [3].

The 32K cost ₱2,400 early bird, ₱2,800 regular and ₱3,200 late; the 21K ₱2,200 to ₱3,000; the 10K ₱1,600 to ₱2,200; and the 5K ₱1,400 to ₱2,000, all plus admin, web and delivery fees [8]. Entries cannot be refunded, deferred or transferred [8]. The 21K and 32K are for runners aged 18 and over [7].

The organiser recommends having your race kit delivered; on-site claiming venues are announced on the series Facebook page, usually at least three days before [8]. Every finisher gets a medal, towel and lootbag, and 21K and 32K finishers a finisher's shirt [8]. Runners who complete all three legs and the National Finals get a running cap, and those who complete the trilogy in more than one city a special medal [8][12].

sections.heading: Should You Enter Davao Leg 3 in 2027?
paragraphs: Yes, if you are working towards a first marathon and live in or near Davao: the 32K with a six-hour limit is a supported long run, and it completes the qualifying set for the National Finals 42K. It also suits a fast club runner: tenth place in the 2026 32K took 2:46:13 for men and 3:29:05 for women.
Think twice if you want to know the route and water stops in advance, or if you do not cope with saturated air: at the 2026 start the humidity was 100%.

No 2027 dates had been published when this was written, and no race report on the 2026 Leg 3 had yet appeared. The official results may still be revised; the rules say they are uploaded two days after the race [7].
Nobody from this site ran the race. This review draws on the organiser's race pages and rules, the full results, airport weather records and SunStar Davao's reports on earlier legs.

faqs.question: What are the cut-off times at Trilogy Run Davao Leg 3?
faqs.answer: Six hours for the 32K, four hours for the 21K, two hours for the 10K and one hour for the 5K, and only finishers inside the limit get a medal. In 2026 all 421 finishers in the 32K results came in under six hours; the slowest ran 5:58:58 and the median was 4:26:13.

faqs.question: How humid is it at Trilogy Run Davao Leg 3?
faqs.answer: Extremely. At the 3am listed start in 2026, Davao's airport recorded 25°C, a dew point of 25°C and 100% humidity with almost no wind. It stayed near saturation until 6am, then climbed to 29°C by 8am and 30°C by 9am, when the slowest 32K runners were finishing.

faqs.question: Does Davao Leg 3 qualify you for the Trilogy National Finals marathon?
faqs.answer: Yes, if you also finished the 16K in Leg 1 and the 21K in Leg 2, in any host city. Those three runs are the only way into the 42K at the National Finals, held on 8 November in 2026. Davao's 27 September leg was the last Leg 3 of the 2026 series.

faqs.question: How fast is the 32K at Trilogy Run Davao Leg 3?
faqs.answer: Fast at the front, open behind. In 2026 Rico Bansilan won in 1:57:16 and Leedy Erika Villamonte in 2:35:26, but tenth place was 2:46:13 for men and 3:29:05 for women. Only 23 runners broke three hours, and the median finish was 4:26:13.

faqs.question: How much does Davao Leg 3 cost and what do finishers get?
faqs.answer: In 2026 the 32K cost ₱2,400 early bird to ₱3,200 late, and the 5K ₱1,400 to ₱2,000, plus admin, web and delivery fees, with no refunds, deferrals or transfers. Every finisher gets a medal, towel and lootbag, and 21K and 32K finishers also get a finisher's shirt.

editorial_notes: Rewritten 2026-09-29 about the 2026 Leg 3, run on 27 September 2026, replacing a review of the 2025 Leg 3. No news report or runner account of the 2026 Leg 3 had been published when this was written, so the review rests on the organiser's pages, the Race Roster results (last modified on race day; the rules say official results come two days later) and airport weather; SunStar Davao's reports on earlier Davao legs give course and field context and are labelled by year. Weather is from airport METAR observations, not a forecast; the airport-to-venue distance is an estimate from map coordinates. Race Roster lists only a 3am event time, and the results carry no start timestamps, so per-distance start times are unknown. No route map, aid-station list or road-closure notice was found. Times are chip times; placings are on gun time. Leg 1 field: KinetixSports gave about 2,700; the results list 2,279. No rating.
